mostWorthwhile.text: Cooling the molten droplets into chondrules was most worthwhile: their textures preserve evidence of rapid heating and cooling.

leastWorthwhile.text: The run of only-offered combinations made the inner-disk route feel somewhat linear, even though the explanations were useful.

surprise.text: Inherited ice can survive in the outer disk without every grain melting and refreezing, while inner-disk grains can be reprocessed by heat.

arbitrary.text: Brief intense heating had a clear effect, but its cause remained unspecified; the result explained that the mechanism is disputed rather than presenting an invented answer.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the stone, metal and ice become larger bodies, especially after the distinction that a mixture is not yet a planet.
